faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Persian?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-12 lb (3-5.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Persian?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Brachycephalic airway concerns; Polycystic kidney disease (PKD) risk; Dental disease. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Persian at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Persian default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
